purpose: Short-lived provider-first collision proof that targets one exact existing Account/EmailIdentity and requires explicit authenticated consent before linking.

columns.name: external_link_challenge_ref
columns.meaning: Stable row ref for this short-lived link challenge.

columns.name: target_account_ref
columns.meaning: Exact existing Account that must be proven before linking.

columns.name: target_email_identity_ref
columns.meaning: Exact existing EmailIdentity that caused the provider-first collision.

columns.name: subject
columns.meaning: Verified provider subject to be linked after proof/consent.

columns.name: provider_email_address
columns.meaning: Non-authoritative provider mailbox hint captured from proof.
columns.value_contract: Optional max 320; never an automatic merge key.

columns.name: provider_email_private
columns.meaning: Provider-reported private/relay property for the email hint.
columns.value_contract: Present iff provider email hint is present.

columns.name: apple_auth_grant_ref
columns.meaning: Pending Apple grant that must be bound or revoked with this challenge lifecycle.

columns.name: continuation_verifier
columns.meaning: Verifier for the Secure HttpOnly link-flow continuation capability.
columns.value_contract: Exactly 32 bytes; raw capability never persists.

foreign_keys.name: fk_external_link_challenge_target_account_ref_account
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Target an existing Account that must be proven before explicit linking.

foreign_keys.name: fk_external_link_challenge_target_email_account_email_identity
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Database-enforce exact collision mailbox ownership by the target Account.

foreign_keys.name: fk_external_link_challenge_apple_grant
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: For Apple, bind the challenge to the exact same grant issuer+subject so pending grant A cannot be attached to provider subject B.

unique_constraints.name: uq_external_link_challenge_issuer_subject
unique_constraints.reason: Only one live provider-first link challenge per provider identity.

check_constraints.name: ck_external_link_challenge_provider_email
check_constraints.expression_contract: provider email hint/private flag all-or-none and bounded
check_constraints.reason: Keep optional mailbox evidence structurally coherent.

check_constraints.name: ck_external_link_challenge_provider_grant
check_constraints.expression_contract: Google has no Apple grant; Apple requires one

indexes.name: ix_external_link_challenge_target_account_ref
indexes.reason: Target Account lookup and FK support.

indexes.name: ix_external_link_challenge_target_email_identity_ref
indexes.reason: Target EmailIdentity lookup and composite FK support.

indexes.name: ix_external_link_challenge_apple_auth_grant_ref
indexes.reason: Pending Apple grant reconciliation and FK support.

state_history.current_binding: One challenge targets one exact Account/EmailIdentity and one verified provider subject.
state_history.immutability_policy: Verified provider and target Account evidence are immutable after challenge creation.

lifecycle.retention: Ephemeral security proof deleted after terminal consume/transition or bounded expiry cleanup.
lifecycle.redaction: Provider evidence, target Account/mailbox refs and continuation verifier are security-sensitive.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: Runtime DELETE only for terminal consumption/cleanup; no UPDATE surface.

obligations: M5 real PostgreSQL exact Account/email/Apple-subject targeting, continuation uniqueness and immutable challenge ACL proof
